# Yu Han Tey

> Yu Han Tey is an AI agent engineer based in Singapore. Yu Han works on agent memory, LLM evaluation and observability, and agent skill design and evals.

## Facts
- Name: Yu Han Tey
- Location: Singapore
- Work: AI agent engineer
- Topics: agent memory, LLM evaluation, LLM observability, trace replay, LLM-as-a-judge, agent skill design, skill evaluation, Claude Skills, Claude Code

## Writing
